entries.e8a2192c0f73e: $~Hap-tsok tsiūnn-tsîn tann ē ŏ-tsi̍t-ê pió-keh lāi-té lia̍t-tshut lóng-tsóng ē-tàng sip-tio̍h lí ê tsuan-àn ê lâng, koh ū tsi̍t-ê tsuann-tan, hōo lí kā múi-ê lâng siat-tīng sī hap-tsok, pit-kì, khòaⁿ, ia̍h-sī tsiap-siū tsò sóo-ū-lâng.
entries.ec340cb6a8402: $~Liâu-thinn tann ùi kóng-uē khai-sí: khui tsiūnn-tsîn ê sî, sìn-sit-keh sûi-sī-hó, sàng tē-it-ê sìn-sit tō siōng-sik liâu-thinn.
entries.eadb738374a96: $~Lí teh siá sìn-sit ê sî, lâng ê lia̍t-pió ē sok-sè tsò tsi̍t-lia̍t, kóng-ē lóng ē-tàng khòaⁿ-tio̍h lí kóng ê lâng, án-ne tuì-uē tō ū kui-ê tsiūnn-tsîn.
entries.e9086ec6be82d: $~"Hoan-ik sìn-sit kàu" kap "Guá teh ēng ___ siá" tsit nn̄g-ê tshuann-tan tann khiā tī sìn-sit-keh téng-bīn ê tsi̍t-lia̍t, múi-ê pâng-pinn ê tshâ-tshōe bô tī-teh.
entries.e55c357643d75: $~Wordplay lia̍t-tshut lâng ê múi-ê tē-hng, tann lóng ēng kāng-iūnn ê pió-keh, ka-ji̍p kap thè-tiāu ê pān-huat tī múi-ūi lóng tông, iā ā tshiūnn nn̄g-ê ia̍h-sī koh-khah-ke ê lâng tsiàm-tsi̍t-hâng, lâi sok-té tn̄g ê lia̍t-pió.
entries.e8e96a3a64860: $~Lí ê thong-ti tann tī lí teng-tshut liáu-āu bē koh tshun. Tī kong-iōng ê tiān-náu, āu tsi̍t-ê lâng khó-lêng khòaⁿ-tio̍h siá hōo lí ê kéng-kò. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e782142100132: $~Koaiⁿ-tiāu tsò-huat thong-ti, bē koh kā lí kî-thaⁿ ê thong-ti lóng tshing-tiāu. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e0c9b117ed451: $~Lí tann mā ē tsai-iánn lí bô tī-teh ê sî kàu ê sìn-sit, m̄-sī tsí-ū ia̍h khui-teh ê sî kàu ê tsiah ū. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ed8006c604309: $~Tsi̍t-ê tsuan-àn lāi-té ū kuí-ê pī-pò kò ê sìn-sit, tann tshut-hiān kuí-ê thong-ti, m̄-sī tsi̍t-ê bē-tsáu-tio̍h ê. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.ef0519ca44b91: $~Liâu-thinn sìn-sit téng-bīn ê pò-kò kî, bē koh tsi̍t-pái ka múi-ê sìn-sit ê pò-kò-keh lóng khui-khí-lâi. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e072fdfb6068a: $~Kâng-ê tāi-tsì pò nn̄g pái, bē koh pió-sī nn̄g-ê pò-kò. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e1cfdf4680dd9: $~Tsit-má tsí-ū tsuan-àn ê tsú-lâng tsiah ē-sái sak-tiāu i ê liām-thian, bô koh ū-lâng tī liām-thian lāi-té lóng ē-sái. (<938@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/938>)
entries.e7f6016c635fe: $~Tsit-má múi-ê lâng lóng ū tsit-khuán koân-lī, só-í lâng bē koh tī hô-tsok tiàm-á tshut-hiān nn̄g pái, kū-ê tsuan-àn ē tī lí thâu-tsit-pái kái tāi-tsì ê sî-tsūn ka-kī kái-hó.
entries.e5e34ff0b8788: $~Lí su-ji̍p ê miâ nā-sī bē-sái-tit ēng, kóng sī-án ê sìn-sit tsit-má ē phiau tī tsuan-pōo ê téng-bīn, tòng-tòng tī khuànn-á ê ē-bīn, bē koh hőo tshìn-tuāⁿ iah-sī khìnn tī ân-lioh ê āu-piah.
entries.e603d548cad47: $~Tsit-má tī ū tsiok-tsē hâng siá-jī ê khuànn-á, hiăn-sī khì-tong-tshut-lâi ê tshi-lé-á ē kā lí tuā-siaⁿ tsí miâ sī-án hō lâng pàng-khì.
entries.e054146a10d97: $~Lí tsit-má ē-sái tshâ-tshuē <tián-lám-kuán@https://wordplay.dev/galleries>: su-ji̍p tsi̍t-ê jī, tō ē khuànn-tio̍h sio-tuì ê tián-lám-kuán, sī-huān tsuan-àn, kap lâng hun-hióng ê tián-lám-kuán ê tsuan-àn. (<299@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/299>)
entries.eba2348e140c6: $~Beh kā lí ê tián-lám-kuán liát-tshut-lâi, tsit-má sī tsi̍t-ê iau-kiû, ài tsú-tshî-lâng khuànn kòe; lí ê tián-lám-kuán ia̍h-bīn ē kóng sī teh tán, í-keng liát-tshut-lâi, iah-sī hőo lâng phah-tńg-tshut-khì, tsīn-lâi ê sî-tsūn ē tsit-ê thong-ti. (<1311@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1311>)
entries.ea93449b22f62: $~Lak-ê bô tī ta̍k-ê tián-lám-kuán ê sī-huān, tsit-má kàu tī tsi̍t-ê, lí ē-sái tshuē-tio̍h: Adobo Recipe, Color Show, Laughing, Layouts, Mumble, kap Wild Transforms.
entries.ea9e054710764: $~Lí tsit-má ē-sái kā tsi̍t-ê sû-hui-tsí ê jī ê kî-thaⁿ siá-huat ka-tī, hō \@parameters\ chit-khuán liân-kiat bau-hâm tsit-ê uân-tsíng ê jī, hoan-ik ê lâng iū-koh ū tsi̍t-ê sin ê Glossary ia̍h-á thang ka-thiam kap sak-tiāu. (<1244@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1244>)
entries.eea11050ebd13: $~Lán hō tsit-ê sû-hui-tsí ê jī iah-sī i ê ì-sù khah-hó kái: lí tsit-má ē-sái tī <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> khuànn-tio̍h ê sî-tsūn chiah-tòh kái, bián tī tn̂g-tn̂g ê bûn-jī lāi-té tshuē. (<1244@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1244>)
entries.e6138d0834ca8: $~Nā-sī lí tsān-tsān hoan-ik Wordplay, lí tsit-má ē-sái tī lí tshiūⁿ-khuànn ê sî-tsūn tō-tòh kái pian-tsi̍t-khì ūi lí ê code tshut-hiān ê būn-tê ê pit-kì — tsiok-tsiok tuán-tuán ê būn-tê miâ, kap kái-sik tsit-ê būn-tê ê kù — bián tī tn̂g-tn̂g ê tsu-liāu lāi-té tshuē. Kù lāi-té ka-kī thiam ê pōo-hūn, chhin-chhiūⁿ ū būn-tê ê mih-kiānn ê miâ, kái ê sî-tsūn lóng tsāi-tsāi, pó-tsûn liáu-āu pit-kì koh-sī pên-siông ê khuànn-huat. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e5b5b6d032c59: $~Sio-kāng ê lō-ráu, lí tsit-má ē-sái kái pian-tsi̍t-khì kóng tsi̍t-tuāⁿ code sī siáⁿ-mih, kap lóng-tsóng ê loh-á-tsuè ê pang-tsān bûn-jī, bô-lūn in tī tá-ūi tshut-hiān. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e27e31d0327cc: $~Tī tián-lám-kuán hun-hióng ê tsò-huat, tsit-má kap kî-thaⁿ ê tsò-huat tsòng tī <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide>, ēng hun-hióng in ê tián-lám-kuán lâi hun-tsóo. (<1277@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1277>)
entries.e82d0f81cac3d: $~Tián-lám-kuán ia̍h-bīn tsit-má múi pái lâi ê sî-tsūn ēng sin ê sūn-sī hiăn-sī kong-khai ê tián-lám-kuán, nā-sī iáu bô liát-tshut-lâi ê tián-lám-kuán, tō ē kóng. (<1311@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1311>)
entries.e2909f3fbc5d3: $~Tī pún-tē-huà mô-sik, kái ê àn-niú tsit-má tsí-ū tī tsin-tsiàⁿ ū-mih thang kái ê tē-hng chiah tshut-hiān. (<1275@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1275>)
entries.e9ad8767d59a7: $~Tī àm-sik mô-sik, tshâ-tshuē kiat-kó lāi-té tsí-tiòh ê jī tsit-má ê tsháu-sik ū-kàu àm, tī i ê ng-sik pōe-kíng téng ē-sái khuànn.
entries.e11b76456f175: $~Lán kā <kàu-ha̍k@https://wordplay.dev/learn> lāi-té ê Python, JavaScript, kap Java ê iūⁿ-sik tsāi-tsāi siá tńg-lâi in pún-lâi siá ê iūⁿ-á, tī múi-ê gí-giân lóng-sī.
entries.e75875093e046: $~Kàu 50 hâng kàu-ha̍k ê kù kóng beh lí ka-tī tshì, bô hō lí khuànn — tsit-kù kóng ēng \+\, lāi-té bô \+\. Lán kā khuí-bô ê lē-tsuè thiam tńg-khì Pho-tô-gâ-gí, Se-pan-gâ-gí, Hindi, kap Tióng-bûn.
entries.e7624705a3c68: $~Tī Se-pan-gâ-gí kap Tióng-bûn ê kàu-ha̍k, lán sak-tiāu bóo-kuí-ê kak-sik kóng nn̄g pái ê kù.
entries.ee13189b51a5c: $~Kàu gí-giân piau-kì ê lē-tsuè tī múi-ê gí-giân lóng bô-khì in ê piau-kì, hiăn-sī \'hello'\ lâi-tsuè \'hello'/en\. In tsit-má koh kàu tńg-lâi in ê iōng-tô, beh pâng tī kî-thaⁿ gí-giân ê bûn-jī bē koh hoan-ik tiāu.
entries.e1a2d93fef84b: $~Tshiù-khik im-ga̍k, kì-lōk iû-hì, kap tsuan-ū ê sī-tshiù kok-tsuā ê tsò-huat, tsit-má tī múi-ê gí-giân lóng-sī siāng-sin ê.
entries.ee7a9112b7f8c: $~Lán kái-tsing ōe kéng sai ê miâ, hō lí ē-sái su-ji̍p <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> hiăn-sī ê. Tī tsa̍p-tsi̍t-ê gí-giân, tsi̍t-ê lia̍t-piáu pau-hâm ê tsióng-luī ê jī tsiah-bián-kiù sī sī-hó-sim ê jī; tī Pho-lân-gí, tsi̍t-ê \Set\ sī jiàn-tsiòh-pâi ê tōng-tsuē; Hi-pik-lâi-gí ū ngóo-ê miâ tuà bô-lâng su-ji̍p ê hû-hō. (<1324@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1324>)
entries.ee29500571349: $~Hō @Phrase tsi̍t-ê \bubble\, i ē tī tsí-tiòh i ê tuì-ōe-hiông-á kóng-ōe; thiam bûn-jī, tsi̍t-ê @Say hō i kóng-tshut-siaⁿ, iah-sī tsi̍t-ê @Bubble tsíng-lia̍t ê sik-tshái iah-sī tsò sūn-sióng. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e7404f9fdc62e: $~Tuì-ōe-hiông-á ka-kī tshuē ūi tī kóng-ōe ê lâng ê téng-bīn iah-sī piⁿ-á, lí ê bú-tâi tō ē khang-ūi, bô-ē tshut-khì kha-bīn. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e0540614e717a: $~Lán tī <tián-lám-kuán@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> thiam tsi̍t-ê sin ê lē-tsuè, miâ Dialog, lāi-té nn̄g-ê jī teh kóng jī ē kóng-ōe sī-án kî-kuài. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e1c506ceee5f0: $~@Row tsit-má thang kā i ê lāi-iông tuì-tsê tī kui-kin-sūn, tsū-sī jī-bó khùn ê hiah tsiàn sòaⁿ, án-ne sió-ê \a\ kah koân-ê \b\ tō ē khuànn-khí-lâi sī tsi̍t tsiàn, m̄-sī nn̄g tsiàn. Kā hit tsiàn ê tuì-tsê soán \_\.
entries.edc2e7b1223ec: $~Múi tsióng jī-thé tsit-má lóng ē kóng-tshut i khuànn-khí-lâi ê iūnn-á, jī-hîng ū 12 ê sû, kám-kak ū 13 ê sû, mā í-king hoan-ik kàu Wordplay ē-hiáu ê múi tsióng gí-giân. (<298@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/298>)
entries.e66b9b9fb8182: $~Kā tsi̍t-ê mi̍h-kiānn the̍h-kīn lēng-gōa tsi̍t-ê, i tō ē tsiap tiàm piⁿ-á, tiong-ng, ia̍h-sī kui-kin-sūn, koh ū tsi̍t tiâu sòaⁿ lâi tsi̍h lí khuànn tsit-ê tuì-tsê; khui-ê sî i ē tsiap kàu keh-á, àn Alt ia̍h-sī Option tō thang pâi tī án-tsuánn kâng ê khuànn-hōo. (<117@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/117>)
entries.ed22be03fc599: $~Hong-hiòng-kiān ē suá lí soán ê mi̍h-kiānn, àn tsiah-ê shift ē tiô kàu ē-tàng tuì-tsê ê ē-tsi̍t-ê, Wordplay mā ē kā lí kóng i lo̍h tī toh-uī. (<117@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/117>)
entries.e0893676698af: $~Tiau-sik-pán tsit-má téng-bīn ū tsi̍t-lia̍p + button, thang kā phrase, tn̂g-hông-hîng, ôan-hîng, to-kak-hîng, sòaⁿ, im-gak, tâng-sî kóng-uē ke kàu lí ê bú-tâi.
entries.e25ae8a0e7f65: $~Sin ê mi̍h-kiānn ē lo̍h tī lí bú-tâi hiān-tsāi ê mi̍h-kiānn ē-bīn, Wordplay mā ē tshiau-tsú i, lí tō thang liâm-mī kái; nā-sī lí seng soán-tioh tsi̍t-ê, i tō ē tī i ê piⁿ-á.
entries.ef5e5847cfd04: $~Tī bú-tâi tsiūⁿ soán nn̄g-ê ia̍h-sī koh-khah tsōe-ê mi̍h-kiānn, àn 🔳 kā in tsip-tsò-hóe sûn-tsò @Group. Nā bē-sái, button ē kóng sī sī-án-tsuánn. (<119@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/119>)
entries.ec4aeeea3bfec: $~Lí tsit-má thang tsò ôan-hîng ia̍h-sī to-kak-hîng, m̄-nā tn̂g-hông-hîng, mā thang kā múi-ê hîng-ìng ìn-tsò \▭\, \●\, ia̍h-sī \⬢\.
entries.eb7ad973482e4: $~Lí tsit-má thang tī bú-tâi tsiūⁿ ōe: àn khí-pit-á, jiân-āu thua tsò tsi̍t tsiàn sòaⁿ, ia̍h-sī múi-ê oat-uan tō tiám tsi̍t-ē, mā thang iōng hong-hiòng-kiān kah Enter bô iōng sè-á-sú tō ōe, àn Escape tō uân-sîng. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e2a8ce685236b: $~Lí ōe-uân tsi̍t tsiàn sòaⁿ liáu-āu, khí-pit-á ē ka-kī kuann-tiāu, án-ne lí tō bē bô-ì-tî koh khai-sí tsi̍t tsiàn sin ê; nā-sī lí ê program sī khang-khang, i ē hō lí tsi̍t-ê @Stage thang ōe. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.ed44130ff0fd4: $~Sin ê hîng-iūnn, @Path, ē kuè tsi̍t tsūn uī-tì uē tsi̍t tiâu sòaⁿ, lí ē-sái án-ne siá: \╱\. Beh khiàm \closed\ lâi kā āu-bóe ê uī-tì liân tńg-lâi tē-it ê, \smooth\ lâi ūi-tio̍h uī-tì uan-uan-á kuè, mài tī uī-tì tńg-wan, \thickness\ lâi kóng sòaⁿ beh uē gōa tshoo. Kàu-ha̍k ē thang tsiânn-tsuē tsi̍t tsūn pîng-siông ê uī-tì lia̍t-pió, in-ūi án-ne, bô-lūn siánn-mih tsiah-sī sán-seng uī-tì, long ē-sái uē, @Contour iā-sī: tse ē kā jī ê guā-lîng uē--tshut-lâi. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e415caf1fb749: $~Kéng lí uē ê sòaⁿ, thuê i ê thîn-á iā-sī iōng tiôngkháng-kiān ê ē-sái kā i uan, ànn Enter ē-sái tī tiong-kan ke tsi̍t ê uī-tì, ànn Delete ē-sái sak tsi̍t ê. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e9677e5f3097a: $~Tsit-má tī lí ê @Stage téng ê @Path, ē ēng i ê si̍t-tsāi hîng-iūnn lâi tòng-tsū mih-kiānn, lí ē-sái uē tsi̍t tè-sūi iā-sī tsi̍t tiâu kok-tsáu, khuànn mih-kiānn kún-lo̍h-khì. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e1edaf8d76442: $~Hō tsi̍t ê hîng-iūnn \glyphs\, Wordplay ē kā hit-ê bûn-jī tsūn-tsūn siá tī i ê piⁿ-á, tsiah-nī jī ē-sái uan-uan lâi liân tsi̍t ê îⁿ, iā-sī iōng jī lâi uē tsi̍t tiâu sòaⁿ. (<167@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/167>)
entries.e760f1bb49f86: $~Tsit-má hîng-iūnn ū \filled\ kah \stroked\, lí ē-sái tsí ū gōa-lîng, iā-sī lóng bô, án-ne tsiū ē-sái tsò tsi̍t tsâng pâng, ē tòng-tsū mih-kiānn, kán-sī khuànn bô.
entries.efdd7f448264d: $~Lí tsit-má ē-sái iōng gí-giân ê miâ lâi siá gí-giân piau-kì, m̄-tsí-sī iōng tāi-bé: \'hola'/Español\, \'hola'/Spanish\, kah \'hola'/es\ lóng sī kāng-ê ì-sù, \/es-México\ kah \/es-MX\ iā sī. Tuā-siá kah im-tiāu lóng bô kuan-hē, \/espanol\ iā ē sái. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e7eb71f8ff482: $~Tsit-má, tuè gí-giân piau-kì lāi-té ê tē-khu, Wordplay nā m̄-bat, ē kā lí kóng, kah gí-giân kāng-khuán. Ū-sî siá m̄-tio̍h, tshiūⁿ \/en-Merica\, í-chêng sī bô-siánn-mih ì-sù. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e30b0c78ef797: $~Tsit-má lí ē-sái siá tsi̍t pō-hūn lâi kā gí-giân piau-kì siá uân. Siá \/esp\ tsiah kéng \/español\, \/span\ tsiah kéng \/Spanish\, iā-sī \/en-U\ tsiah kéng \/en-US\, siá tsi̍t-kuá liáu-āu, kui-ê gí-giân kah tē-khu lóng ē ū, m̄-tsí-sī Wordplay kóng ē-hiáu ê. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e7f8b348cd7ac: $~Sann ê ê-á tsit-má iōng uē-tuì-kháng lâi thè-tāi iōng ka-kī khǹg ê jī: tī tē-tôo téng, tú-tio̍h tsi̍t ê tē-hng ē kā lí kóng ê, ē kóng lí ê sim-tsîng ê bīn, kah kó-tsāi Pears. (<75@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/75>)
entries.e786e5ca323da: $~Lí ê Program nā ū tsiok-tsē mih-kiānn ē hián-sī, tsit-má in tio̍h-ē khǹg tī lí kóng ê só-tsāi. Bô ka-kī uī-tì ê mih-kiānn tsit-má ē tsuè tī tiong-kan tsàng-tsàng, ūi-tio̍h án-ne hō in uī-tì, iā-sī ka-kī siá @Group, nā-sī lí beh ê sī tsàng-tsàng.
entries.ea30aba547270: $~<Gí-giân kéng-tsik-khì@https://wordplay.dev/> tsit-má ē iōng tsiūⁿ-á ê gí-giân lâi siá tsi̍t ê tē-khu, lí ē khuànn tio̍h "México" kah "日本"; lí iā ē-sái tshâ-tshuē tī lióng-ê miâ. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.ecaba766bb2c1: $~Lí tuì tsâi-tan kéng gí-giân piau-kì ê sî, tsit-má ē sī kā gí-giân miâ-miâ, \/es\ ē tuà "español", \/es-MX\ tuà "español (México)". (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e36a774e1e335: $~Lí siá liáu gí-giân āu-piah, tsit-má ē thê-kiōng ū lâng kóng hit-ê gí-giân ê tē-hng — \/en\ ē thê-kiōng \-US\, \-GB\, kah \-CA\. Ke tsi̍t ê gí-giân ê khuán-sit iû-goân tī lòh-bīn. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e15c0e192cf34: $~Jī-thé kéng-tsik-khì tsit-má kā piau-kì tuà "bô lóng-hîng, tshóo, kui, tshōe-sìn", kā ū tsi̍t ê siá-hoat tuà "Greek", iû-goân ē khuànn tio̍h hu-hō kah jī-bó. (<298@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/298>)
entries.ecbd9d246842b: $~Lán í-keng siu-lí tsit-ê mn̄g-tê: tī lí ê bú-tâi téng tshòng ê sî, í-chêng lóng bô kéng tio̍h, ē ū lâm-sik ê hîng-iūnn-kiat-tsāu, khuànn bô thîn-á, iā bô-ē-sái ēng tiôngkháng-kiān suá.
entries.eca4cab5a30dc: $~Lí ê bú-tâi tsit-má tī lí thuê mih-kiānn ê sî ē khǹg tiām-tiām, tshōng-khui ê sî tsiah koh hōo lí ê tsok-phín tsio-hô; beh tsai-sin khuànn, tio̍h kā lí ê program tsai-khai-sí.
entries.e7aa56c60cc2d: $~Bīn-pán tuà-khì tsit-má ē kóng "tsú" iā-sī hîng-iūnn ê miâ, m̄-tsí tuà i ê hu-hō, tshiūⁿ "peh sì-hông liu-á".
entries.e363350f72f2f: $~Gí-giân piau-kì nā ū tsiū-tshòng ê tē-khu, tsit-má siu-lí ê sî, kan-na kā tsiū-tshòng ê hit-tsi̍t ê kā sak, m̄-bián kā lí ê kî-thaʼ tē-khu iā sak. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.ead3d948efccc: $~Tsâi-tan tsit-má ē pang-tsān lí siá gí-giân piau-kì: \'hi'/\ ē thê-kiōng gí-giân, \'hi'/en\ ē thê-kiōng tē-khu, \'hi'/en-U\ ē siá uân tsò \/en-US\. (<1220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1220>)
entries.e50f1c2a08ebb: $~Í-chêng ke tsi̍t-tsiah mih-kiānn tī lí ê program ê sî, ē kā lí ê tsuan-àn suat-bîng thuê tsiūⁿ lí ê thîng-sik-bé ê tē-it hâng.
entries.ed93a2b1c05d8: $~Tsit-má kéng @Say ê sî, ē-sái tī tiau-sik-pán lāi-té kái i kóng ê, kah kî-thaʼ mih-kiānn kāng-khuán.
entries.ebabff67170ad: $~Sió hîng-iūnn ê tsiūⁿ, i ê thàu kah tuā-sió thîn-á, kah hîng-iūnn ka-kī, tsit-má lóng ē tuì-tsi̍p, m̄-bián koh ê-tsāi bô kāng-ê tē-hng.
entries.e84362a0cf17f: $~Lán í-keng siu-lí tsi̍t ê îⁿ iā-sī to-pi̍t hîng-iūnn tsò lí ê bú-tâi \frame\ ê sî, ē kā bú-tâi ê m̄-tio̍h pō-hūn tshiah-tiāu ê mn̄g-tê.
entries.e3e061f59b902: $~Tī siat-tīng khui khí tshòng-sî ê thê-sik, tsit-má Wordplay ê program tsi̍t-pái oân, tō ē hoat-tshut tsi̍t-sian té-im, mî-kuè ê ín-sòo ū bô kāng ê siaⁿ. Sî-kan-tsūn ê tshiàⁿ-kuè ē kā in kái-sik. (<537@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/537>)
entries.eb0685942f760: $~Khui tshiong-tu̍t ê siaⁿ-im thê-sī, lí tō ē-sái thiaⁿ tio̍h bú-tâi téng ê mi̍h-kiānn pōng tio̍h: pōng khah tāng, siaⁿ khah toā; kúi-nā ê mi̍h-kiānn tsi̍t-tsūn lo̍h-lâi, tō thiaⁿ khí-lâi kah kúi-nā ê mi̍h-kiānn.
entries.e9e7ab5b65f52: $~Khui tōng-ōe ê siaⁿ-im thê-sī, lí tō ē-sái thiaⁿ tio̍h tōng-ōe: píng-tńg ē piàn im-tiāu, suá-uī ē tshiūⁿ siaⁿ-im uì tsit pêng kàu hit pêng, tàu-tàu siau-sit tō piàn khah sè-siaⁿ. Tāi-tāi huê-khuan ê tōng-ōe múi pái lóng pàng kāng-khuán ê tiāu.
entries.ef02d7f20fbdb: $~Tsit-ma \@Pose\ ē-sái tàu tsi̍t ê \@Music\, hit ê tsú-sè tsiah-tsūn tō ē pàng, bô-lūn lí sī án-ne tsìn-lâi, á sī tī \@Sequence\ lāi-té kàu-ūi. (<22@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/22>)
entries.e7bc02153fad1: $~Tī sè ê hū-bak-tsiàu-á, lí ê code, bú-tâi kah kî-thaⁿ thang-khuànn ê uē-bīn tsit-ma tī tsuan-àn miâ téng-bīn ū ka-tī ê tsi̍t-hâng, ûi-tio̍h án-ne tsi̍t-ē tō ē-sái tshiân-huānn, kā lí teh khuànn ê hit ê uē-bīn tshiâⁿ-tshiâⁿ tō khah tiâu.
entries.ef5dc5b9a2f4e: $~\sorted\ tsit-ma ē-sái ēng tsi̍t ê jī lâi pâi-sūn, m̄-tsí sī sòo-jī, in-ūi án-ne lí ē-sái ēng miâ lâi pâi; emoji ē ùi in sī sīm-mih lâi pâi, in-ūi án-ne sim-sîn ē pâi tī tsi̍t-tīn. (<1322@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1322>)
entries.ed299c55615bc: $~Khui-tio̍h ê button tsit-ma khuànn-khí-lâi ná-tio̍h-sī hō͘ lâng ap lo̍h-khì: ē tîm lo̍h-khì koh piàn-àm, m̄-sī ná khí-khì á-sī tī àm-sik bô̍k-sik khuànn-khí-lâi teh sih.
entries.e09d76b504e47: $~Jī tsit-ma ē uì jī-bú-sūn-sī pâi, tshiūⁿ jī-tián án-ne, in-ūi án-ne "amy" kah "Amy" bô-lūn toā-siá á sī sè-siá lóng ē pâi tī sio- óa. (<1322@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1322>)
entries.e7f28d75afddc: $~Lán í-keng siu-hok tsi̍t ê tòng-khì ê būn-tê, lí tī í-keng ū ê ín-sòo téng-bīn ka-thiam sin ê ín-sòo, tshiūⁿ \Kónguē()\, ê sî-tsūn ē tòng-khì.
entries.ef85c55f84ceb: $~Tsit-ma lí ē-sái tuân-tīng lí ka-thiam ê emoji sī ū sik ê á-sī o͘-pe̍h ê, Wordplay ē kā lí ê soán-tek kì-tio̍h.
entries.ed0eec1a2f2ef: $~Tsit-ma lí ē-sái kiám-tsa hām khóo-pih lí ê tshiūⁿ-sik só͘ tsi̍t-tiỏh ê bûn-jī, tō-sī tī teh pàng ê sî-tsūn mā ē, kan-tan m̄-sī bú-tâi ê mi̍h-kiānn lóng ē-sái.
entries.e0516e739815c: $~Lí ê im-ga̍k pàng ê im-hû tsit-ma ē tī lí ê code lāi-té hoat-kng, in-ūi án-ne tsi̍t ê khuán-tiāu lāi-té múi ê sòo-jī tsiah-tsūn lúi-tio̍h in ê sūn-sū tō ē kng.
entries.e3c68f072160a: $~Code ê tshài-tan tsit-ma ē-sái khí khah-tsē mi̍h-kiānn: uì tsi̍t ê List á-sī Map thài tsi̍t hāng, ēng \→\ kái sòo-jī ê luī-hîng, ēng \???\ lâi mn̄g, ēng \←\ khuànn tsu-liāu-liû ê í-ê, kái tsi̍t ê kiat-kò͘ ê tsi̍t pō͘-hūn, koh kái Table.
entries.e03bfa0d1ffe4: $~Tsit-ma lí ē-sái ēng Lô-má, Hàn, Thài, Bengal, Devanagari, Gujarat, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Tamil kah Telugu ê sòo-jī lâi siá sòo-jī, mā ē-sái ēng 2 ê kî-sòo kah 16 ê kî-sòo. entries.ecafe111b501f: $~Lí ê tsuan-àn tsit-ma ē-sái kah Wordplay kî-thaⁿ ê tō-ūi tsi̍t-tīn piàn-àm, múi ê sik ê sik-siōng kah kāng-kuè ê khang-kan ē pó-liû; í-keng àm ê tsuan-àn ē tsāi-lâi ê khuán, lí mā ē-sái tī siat-tīng lāi-té kā tsit-ê kuann tiāu. (<65@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/65>)

entries.e9675660640c4: $~Tshài-tan tsit-ma ē uì in tshâ-liōng ê mi̍h-kiānn lâi hun-tsiah tan-uī, in-ūi án-ne \km\ tī tn̂g-té, koh tsin-tsiàⁿ ê sòo-jī ê soán-hāng tsàu-tsîng.
entries.e10f245afb245: $~Í-keng tsò-hó ê mi̍h-kiānn, tshiūⁿ \Sūnsū.iô()\ kah \Siktshái.tshìntshái()\, tsit-ma tī lí tī in ê miâ āu-bīn tha̍k tsi̍t tiám ê sî-tsūn ē tshut-hiān.
entries.e05ff5c398e34: $~Lán í-keng siu-hok tshài-tan kā bô-khóo-lêng sái-tit ê code thê-kiong, tshiūⁿ \a()\ tī \a.\ āu-bīn, m̄-sī \a.📏()\, koh tī tsi̍t ê \+\ āu-bīn i ē thê-kiong tsi̍t-kuá kan-tan tī tsîng-bīn hit ê sòo-jī ū-iōng ê mi̍h-kiānn.
entries.e040d7cb12bb1: $~Soán lí tsit-ê choân-pōo ê Program, tshài-tan tsit-ma ē mn̄g lí beh-bē ka-thiam tsi̍t-kuá mi̍h-kiānn, m̄-sī hián-sī khang ê tshài-tan.
entries.ebfcac432c715: $~Tī tshài-tan lāi-té tshiūⁿ jī, siá tsi̍t ê jī, ē thiau-kuè tē-it ê soán-hāng, in-ūi án-ne hit ê bô-hoat-tō͘ án-ne soán.
entries.e9f56cd2abf85: $~Lán í-keng siu-hok emoji kah hû-hō sóo-tshuē-á ê tshiau-tshuē-keh, i í-tsîng siá tē-it ê jī āu-tsūn ē bô-khì lí ê uī-tì.

entries.e3ebfacb03dbd: $~Markup kah luī-hîng piàn-sòo tsit-ma tī <Guide@https://wordplay.dev/guide> ū in ka-tī ê hiàn, markup hit hiàn ū tsi̍t ê lí ē-sái si̍t-tsāi tshì ê lē.

entries.ef29f087556d3: $~Guán í-keng kái-hó tó tsit tuānn code tī bú-tâi téng-kha ê mi̍h-kiānn teh suá-tāng ê sî-tsūn ē tshàu-kng, mā ū pau-kuat \Sūnsū.iô()\ chit-khuán hō͘ lí tshiân-hó ê tōng-tsok. (<543@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/543>)
entries.ea50e30cabb7b: $~Hiān-tsāi, ū o͘-sik piah-kéng ê tsuan-àn ē iōng sio-phīnn ê sik-tshái lâi huì i ê pian-iân kap suànn-tsiah, tsit-ê khuànn khah khuài-tsiah.

entries.e8483e5192db2: $~Ū keh-sik ê bûn-jī hiān-tsāi ē-sái piàn-tsò i ê hû-hō lia̍t-piáu, iā-sī piàn-tsò sò-jī, kap pâng-tsông ê bûn-jī sio-kâng. (<1190@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1190>)
entries.ebe20074872cf: $~Hiān-tsāi lí ē-sái tī ka-kī ê code siá \!#\, tsit-ê m̄-sī sò-jī ê ta̍t. Wordplay lóng ē-hiáu tsò tsit-ê — kā \'hi'\ chit-khuán bûn-jī piàn-tsò sò-jī tō ē tit-tio̍h i — m̄-koh ka-kī siá pí-tuā ū hông tsò-sī tshò-gō͘.
entries.eb8f091e3d073: $~Guán ê <thâu-ia̍h@https://wordplay.dev/> hiān-tsāi ū tsi̍t-ê bú-tâi, ū káu-ê sió-sió ê thîng-sik tī hia piàn-tsò, múi-ê ê code tō tī pâng-pinn. (<921@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/921>)
entries.ee044b13ccb3a: $~@Output hiān-tsāi ē-sái iōng \pull\ khiā sio-sut kā pa̍t-ê @Output ngiàⁿ-khí-lâi, iā-sī iōng hù-ê ta̍t kā i-tsit; khuànn <tián-lám-kuán@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> lāi-té sin ê Orbits lē-tsí. (<20@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/20>)
entries.e69f7868e7db1: $~@Stage hiān-tsāi ū \air\, ē siat-tīng teh suá-tāng ê @Output siánn-mi̍h kuài-sut: 1 sī tsiàⁿ-siông, 0 sī ú-tiōng khong-kan. (<20@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/20>)
entries.e7416d92da3f7: $~Hiān-tsāi lí ē-sái tī huì-hó liáu-āu kái-hó lō-kìng: tī <jī-bú@https://wordplay.dev/characters> pian-tsi̍p-khì ké-tsi̍t-ê, tshi̍h enter, tō ē-sái suá, ka, iā-sī thâi i ê tiám. (<667@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/667>)

entries.ed8107c38269b: $~Jī-bú pian-tsi̍p-khì hiān-tsāi ē kā bīn-bak-tuì-tsuí khuànn-bô ê lâng kóng lí tsiah-á tsò siánn: suá, huì, thâi, uân-sîng, thâi-tiāu, tńg-tsiah, khóo-pih, tah-tsiah, ūnn-sūn-sī, píng-tńg, iā-sī ōaⁿ tsi̍t-ê tiám. (<666@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/666>)

entries.e1b0d145c7c38: $~Lí ànn kiān ê tápkài, tsit-má lâi-tsiū kóng; tshin-tsiânn ê siau-sit, tú-tú sió-bih kā tsia̍h kóng, kuā-tī, ǹg-bián ê, tōo-hōo-tshiau-khuànn khah-liâu, hōo siau-sit bē sio-tshap.
entries.e7664851e2a5a: $~Lí kiò-kuí-tsiah gí-giân ê sî, kóng-uē ê piau-tê tsit-má tsí-ū iōng tē-it-ê.
entries.e582034caa20a: $~Lí bāng-tsār hoān-ik tsi̍t-kù ū kè-sǹg mih-kiānn ê uē ê sî, tsit-má lóng hōo lí tsi̍t-ê khang-uī, tùi-ìng lí ê gí-giân ê múi-tsi̍t-khuán kè-sǹg-hong-sik, tsāi-kā tshuē tsi̍t-ê kap i tùi-tsiū ê sò-jī, koh kā lí ê uē múi-khuán ē kóng siánn ū-tsiah kóng-tshut-lâi. (<1250@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1250>)
entries.eadac2f4a99bf: $~Guá-tī kā múi-khuán thîng-sik-bé ká-ê kò-kò kóng-kè ê ūn-sàu, kái-sè hit-ê-khuán kui-tī: ta̍t kóng i sī siánn-mih, tāi-uī "5 meters" kap "true"; piáu-ta̍t-sik kóng i teh tsò siánn-mih, tāi-uī "evaluate Phrase" kap "conditional on true".
entries.e636027153886: $~Thîng-sik-bé iáu ū siá-tshut-lâi ê miâ ê sî, bīn-bo̍k-tha̍k-khì-ki bē koh kóng emoji — kâng-tsi̍t-ê hâm-sò ê miâ ū 💬 kap Phrase, tsit-má kóng "Phrase". Tsí-ū mih-kiānn tsí-ū emoji tsit-ê miâ ê sî, tsiah ē kóng emoji.
entries.eb3b6bf17c8e4: $~Liân-tsò tsi̍t-ê jī siá ê miâ, tāi-uī \eyesOpen\, tsit-má ē pài-khai tha̍k-tsò kuí-ê jī, "eyes open", hōo lí thiann--tio̍h khah-hó tsūn.
entries.e1b0f81e4bf03: $~Pau-tio̍h kî-thâ thîng-sik-bé ê thîng-sik-bé, tsit-má ē kóng i lāi-té ū siánn-mih, tāi-uī "conditional on operation greater than on n and 3". (<555@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/555>)
entries.ea83808e5f5be: $~Suat-bîng ê pō-hūn tsit-má ē kóng i pau siánn-mih: gí-giân kap jī-sò, bûn-jī, kap thîng-sik-bé. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.eef5aa017ac4d: $~Tsit-má pattern ê ta̍k-tè mā ē kóng in té siánn-mih: capture ē kóng i ê miâ, tsiâu-kāng ê bûn-jī ē kóng i ê jī, huān-uî ē kóng i ê nn̄g-thâu. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.e0b0b90415539: $~Tsuan-àn teh sái ê sî, lí ànn ê kiān, tsit-má bē koh tshéng-tuān hôe-èng ê miâ-sû, mā bē koh hoat-tshut kíng-pò ê siann.
entries.e285bb32bb563: $~Tī thîng-sik-bé khah-khuá ê tē-hng, phah ūn-sǹg-hû tāi-uī \~\ á-sī \-\, tsit-má ē ka-tī ke tsi̍t-ê khang-uī, kā lí ê tsí-piau khǹg tī tsia, \~\ tō piàn-tsò \~_\. Siánn-mih tē-hng ū siūnn-beh thîng-sik-bé to ē-sái, tāi-uī khang ê sū-tsîng, \(\ á-sī \[\ lāi-té, á-sī \⊤ &\ ê āu-piah.
entries.e8aac8a17a293: $~Iáu bē tsò-uân ê hôe-èng, tsit-má ē kóng i teh tán tó-tsi̍t-pō-hūn, tāi-uī "missing condition", m̄-sī "unreadable code". I mā ē sái-tāng, tī lí tsò-uân-tsìng tsìn-tsiū ê tsìng-tshù-ta̍t.
entries.e19df165bf0f6: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, tsuan-àn teh sái ê sî, lí kái i ê thîng-sik-bé, i tō ē khiā-tiâu, tsit-má bē ah.
entries.ed71f652394f0: $~Guá-tī ūn-tsè liân khah-sī ê bûn-jī, tāi-uī liên-kiat, tshò-ngōo siau-sit, kap hōo-huǐ ê jī, tī kng-ê môo-sik khah-àm, tī àm-ê môo-sik khah-kng. (<1183@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1183>)
entries.eeb1e077576a3: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, lí sak ê sî pian-tsi̍t-khì bē kóng-uē: múi-tsi̍t-pái sak lóng ē kóng ia sak-tiāu ê jī, sak khah-tsē ê, tō kóng bu̍t-tsiah-sit tsīn-tsū.
entries.efc1e19bc5be8: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, lí ê tsí-piau kàu tsi̍t-hâng ê bué, pian-tsi̍t-khì ē tuā-siann kóng "Unparsable template".
entries.ed649bc4cba1c: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, lí ê tsí-piau lo̍h-tī suat-bîng lāi-té ê \$name\ ê sî, bīn-bo̍k-tha̍k-khì-ki ē kóng bô-ì-sù ê sò-jī. Tsit-má i ē kóng miâ. (<1252@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1252>)
entries.ef5e786f9d753: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, tsi̍t-ê tsi̍t-ê mih-kiānn ê kè-sǹg-jī: tsi̍t-ê mih-kiānn ê tsú-liat, tsit-má kóng "list of 1 value", múi-ê gí-giân lóng ū tsìng-khak ê kè-sǹg. (<1250@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1250>)
entries.eb52b656106d9: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng 545 tiâu siū-sún ê liên-kiat, tī 30 ê gí-giân ê suat-bîng lāi-té, hit-tsiah-ê siá-tsáu khang-khang ê hiòng, m̄-sī i ê tsí-ê jī. (<1245@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1245>)
entries.eea715b06bd86: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, 26 ê gí-giân ê bûn-jī, ē kā thîng-sik-bé ê ki-tsháu, tāi-uī \[$1|and]\, tshut-hiān tī jī ê uī-tì.
entries.e7c165dd8e3c3: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, iōng kiān-pân koaiⁿ hiân-kheh ê sî, bē koh poe-tshiūnn kàu tsiah-iah ê téng-thâu: tsit-má lí ē tńg-khì khui i ê hit-ê button.
entries.e1326abc63656: $~Guá-tī múi-tsi̍t-iah lóng ke thâu-miâ, hōo liân-lám-khì ê tsiah-tsiūnn, kap bīn-bo̍k-tha̍k-khì-ki ē kóng lí ū tī tó-tsi̍t-iah.
entries.ececbd2f2909f: $~Guá-tī kái-hó kóng, bīn-bo̍k-tha̍k-khì-ki kóng bú-tâi téng ū siánn nn̄g-pái: tsi̍t-pái "output phrase hi", koh tsi̍t-pái "new phrase hi". Tsit-má lí tsí-ū thiann tsi̍t-pái, iōng bú-tâi ka-tī ê uē.
entries.ec6837d364d42: $~Guá tshù-lí kah bú-tâi tī lí pian-tsi̍p ê sî-tsūn ka-tī tsuā-tsuā kóng; tsit-má tio̍h-ài lí ànn play liáu-āu, tsiah ē kóng, an-ni bē tshá-tio̍h lí phah-jī.
entries.e8f0916c11ab7: $~Guá tshù-lí kah bú-tâi téng ê hîng-siōng kap tsu̍t-kué bô kóng miâ ê būn-tê; tsit-má in kap phrase kāng-khuán ē hō lí thiannh.
entries.ed53e801b2ace: $~Guá tshù-lí kah screen reader ê suán-tshú gû-khuân tsiok tuā, kèng-kuè lí suán ê code; tsit-má ē ûi kah kīn-kīn-á.
entries.e2a341510df47: $~Guá tshù-lí kah \-1\ chit-khuán piáu-ta̍t-sik tuì screen reader kóng ka-tī sī phoà-khì ê môo-pán, m̄-sī in tsiàm-sit sī siánn-mih.
entries.ef2312eed7110: $~Guá tshù-lí kah iáu-bōe hoan-èk ê bûn-jī tī pat-khuán gí-giân ē tsiùⁿ-tsit "iáu-bōe tuè-tīng" ê sìn-sit; tsit-má ē sé-hôe kàu Eng-bûn, tán hoan-èk siá-hó.
entries.e978bd0755f7f: $~Guá tshù-lí kah tsuan-àn tsi̍t-pái piàn-tsin tsiok-chē — lóng-sī tsi̍t-ê keh-á-tīn tsài-koh-tè-tshiūⁿ — tsi̍t-tsi̍t-ê lóng kóng tshut-lâi ê būn-tê. Tsit-má ē kóng kuí-ê piàn-tsin, tī tuà-uī, kap tsi̍t-ê it-lē, khah-tshiūⁿ "guá ê keh-á-tīn lāi-té 12-ê output piàn-tsin, ná-tshiūⁿ 5." (<555@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/555>)
entries.e988a8db81452: $~Guá tshù-lí kah suat-bîng bô lia̍p lí ka-tī tī @Phrase, @Group, ia̍h-sī @Stage siá ê suat-bîng ê būn-tê. Tsit-má ē thiannh lí siá ê hit-ê.
entries.eeffa1ef34937: $~Guá tshù-lí kah ū-kuí-ê suat-bîng lāi-té ū siang-ê khang-keh, ná-tshiūⁿ "number type in m".
entries.ef5d14dad05f7: $~Guá tshù-lí kah tan-uī ê miâ tsuí-sī kóng Eng-bûn ê būn-tê, bô-lūn lí iōng tó-tsi̍t-ê gí-giân.
entries.e6157584f6379: $~Guá tshù-lí kah lí tī code ê boé-bé phah \~\ sî, pian-tsi̍t-khì tuh-tiàm tī kam-sik ê tshò-ngō· siunn-á ê būn-tê.
entries.ef938cfc06917: $~Nā-sī pian-tsi̍p-khì ū-sî bē-tàng uē lí ê code, tshut-lâi ê siunn-á tsit-má ē kóng tshut-sīnn sím-mih tshò-ngō·, koh ū tsi̍t-ê button hō lí koh-tsi̍t-pái, m̄-bián tuh-tiàm bô lō.
entries.e238f3a60f613: $~Guá tshù-lí kah piáu-sī code khiam-tsió ê piau-kì — tsit-má sī khang-uī lāi-té ê tē-sian, kap lí ê code kî-tha-uī ê tē-sian tsiâu-pênn.
entries.ef5aa07597b35: $~Guá ka-thiam \@Objects\, tsit-ê sin ê input, iōng lí ê siá-ǹg-ki khuànn-tio̍h ji̍t-siông ê mi̍h-kiānn, ēng lí ê gí-giân kóng tshut in sī siánn-mih, koh kā lí kóng ū joa tuā ê pa-ak kap tsi̍t-ê tī tó-uī.
entries.e5ade58dc4e94: $~Guán ka-thiam <Show and Tell@https://wordplay.dev/project/example-ShowAndTell?mode=play>, tī Games tián-lám-kuán ê sin lē-tsú: i hōo lí tshuē saⁿ-hāng mi̍h-kiāⁿ, hō͘ lia̍h tī siòng-siōng-ki ê tsia̍p-ūi — siāng-āu ê hit hāng tio̍h nn̄g-ê lâng — lí ìnn ê sî-tsūn ē tshut-hiān tsin-tsōo ê tsí-tsuá-huē.
entries.e56dc810decb7: $~Guán ka-thiam tsi̍t-ê tsiām-thîng ê hû-hō, nā-sī lí ê tsuan-àn bô teh pàng, ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h tī tshut-lî ê téng-bīn, án-ne tsiū bat-tio̍h sī-án-tsuánn sî-tsing á-sī tōng-ōe thîng-lo̍h-lài.
entries.e23e1062d291e: $~Guán ka-thiam tsi̍t-ê miâ-tsu̍t, hōo huan-ik Wordplay ê lâng iōng. Lí ē-sái hōo tsi̍t-ê tsu̍t-sū kiān-tuā ê kiān, tsiū ē-sái tī tsūn-tsia iōng $ ê āu-bīn ê kiān lâi tsài-sú-iōng, án-ne siāng-tsi̍t-ê sû tī sûi-hāng bûn-jī lóng sio-kāng, beh kái-piàn tsí-bián tī tsi̍t-ê tē-hng. Kiān ē-sái sī sím-mih gí-giân. (<1226@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1226>)
entries.e975a7f5f910a: $~Guán ka-thiam remix: lí khó-pí tsi̍t-ê tsuan-àn ê sî, guán ē hián-sī tsi̍t-ê liân-kiat tńg-khì guân-pún, koh kā tsok-tsiá ê miâ khòaⁿ-tio̍h; hun-hióng-kuán mā ē hián-sī lí ê sī tuì tá-ūi remix lâi ê, kap pa̍t-lâng hun-hióng ê remix. (<788@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/788>)
entries.ef904d6541071: $~Jī-hū kéng-tsik-khì tsit-tsūn ē-sái tshuē-tio̍h lí ê <custom characters@https://wordplay.dev/characters> — su-ji̍p miâ ê tsi̍t-pōo-hūn á-sī tsú-tuê, tsiū ē khòaⁿ-tio̍h tùi-tio̍h ê emoji kap hû-hō. (<669@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/669>)
entries.e7cf8a69a0f2c: $~Teh tsuí-tsong chhiú, bīn, á-sī mi̍h-kiāⁿ ê tsuan-àn, tsit-tsūn ē hián-sī moo-hîng ē-sái ê sū-tsîng, tán i chún-pī hó-sè tsiū khai-sí.
entries.ec5ffec9546dc: $~<Guide@https://wordplay.dev/guide>、huan-ik ê hē-nî, hôe-ìng piáu-tuann, kap jī-hū kéng-tsik-khì tsit-tsūn lóng iōng tab, lí kéng ê tab ē kap ē-bīn ê lōo-iông liân-tòa-lòng.
entries.e480340c4f076: $~Guán kā <Galleries@https://wordplay.dev/galleries> hun-tsò kuí-ê tab — lí ê, lē-tsú, tsò-huat, kap kong-khai — mî-mî tab lóng ū ka-kī ê bāng-tsíʼ ē-sái hun-hióng.
entries.e6f52ed2367d9: $~Tī <Learn@https://wordplay.dev/learn>, guán kā kéng-kò-khuè ê kéng-tsik-khì, tshâ-sûn, kap sī-iōng ê gí-giân kéng-tsik-khì suá-tsiūⁿ khuài kap uân-pān ê tab ê ē-bīn.
entries.e9313d83d58b6: $~Guán kā "khó-pí" ê àn-liú kái-miâ tsò "remix", koh hōo i sin ê hû-hō. (<788@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/788>)
entries.e5dd6b34717d9: $~Hun-hióng-kuán tsit-tsūn iōng tab — Gallery, Public, Preview, Privacy, kap Remixes — lí tī tsiah-ê tab tiong-kan suá, i ē khiā-tiâu.
entries.ed55d04194fb0: $~Tī <Rights@https://wordplay.dev/rights> ia̍h, guán kái-sueh kong-khai ê tsuan-àn sī iōng Creative Commons ê hù-khó, só͘-í pa̍t-lâng ē-sái remix, nā-tshiánn tsok-tsiá ê miâ, koh iōng siāng-iūⁿ ê hun-hióng hong-sik. (<788@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/788>)
entries.e06fb80022e3f: $~Lí tī jī-hū kéng-tsik-khì tshuē ê sî, ē tshut-hiān tsi̍t-ê hóng-tuā-kiàⁿ ê tab, koh ē pó-tsûn, kéng pa̍t-ê tab tsiū ē tshing-tshú tshâ-sûn.
entries.ecd2bb903e30b: $~Guán siu-hók su-ji̍p tsiok kuài ê sî ē tshut-tshuè ê būn-tê, pian-tsi̍t-khì tsit-tsūn ē tī lí kè-sio̍k pian-tsi̍t ê sî, tsuí-tsuí-á ka-kī siu-hó.
entries.e3a535d806846: $~Guán siu-hók liân-kiat khì bô-tsûn-tsāi ê lē-tsú sî, ē tshut-hiān kâi-lōan ê jī, tsit-tsūn ē kā lí kóng tsit-ê tsuan-àn bô-tsûn-tsāi.
entries.ea3e2f6910187: $~Guán siu-hók tsi̍t-kuá jī, "@wordplay" tsit-ê ū-sî kan-tan hián-sī tsò jī, m̄-sī ē-sái tshi̍h ê liân-kiat, ná-tshiūⁿ tī <donate page@https://wordplay.dev/donate>.
entries.e0cb3c097739c: $~Guán siu-hók tī ng-sik pōe-kéng-téng khuà-tsáu ê liân-kiat, ná-tshiūⁿ tī pian-tsi̍t-khì ê pang-tsō liân-kiat; tsit-tsūn sī pe̍h-sik, ē-bīn ū kam-á-sik ê kuà-sòaⁿ.
entries.eaffee97b531e: $~Guán siu-hók \Kóng\ tsuan-àn tī ia̍h tsiah-tsiah tsāi-ji̍p kah tsiām-thîng ê sî tō kóng-ōe; tsit-tsūn i ē tsia̍p-tiâu, kàu lí àn pàng-tsiūⁿ tsiah ē khai-sí.
entries.e0b59d3fc8889: $~Guán siu-hók kéng-tik àn-liú tsóo-tsú, ná-tshiūⁿ àm-sik kap kng-sik pòo-sik kéng-tsik-khì; tsit-tsūn lí tsí-tsi̍t-pái Tab khì tsóo-tsú, jiân-āu iōng ìnn-tsí-kiān.
entries.e9d3408b55dff: $~Guán siu-hók kéng-tik àn-liú tshiánn tsit-ê tooltip hōo tsuí-bîng-khì thiaⁿ; tsit-tsūn i ē kóng ka-kī ê piau-tîm, án-ne mā ū pang-tsō liáu-lō-khòng-tsè siaⁿ-im.
entries.e70f107162321: $~Guán siu-hók lak-lo̍h tshài-tuann tshiat-tuàn ka-kī ê jī; i tsit-tsūn ē phóng-móa i tsiām ê uân-pún khuah-tō.
entries.e087477faeeed: $~Guán siu-hók <Learn@https://wordplay.dev/learn> ê kéng-kò-khuè tī tsi̍t-bōo khai-sí ê sî khòaⁿ-khí-lâi khang-khang; tsit-tsūn ē hián-sī lí tng-teh ê hit-kò kéng-kò.
entries.ec9519d0ec6b7: $~Guán siu-hók iáu-bē pó-tsûn ê tsuan-àn tui-tsāi bô sàng-tshut, nā-sī àn-liú kóng í-keng pó-tsûn; tsit-tsūn i ē tsi̍t-tsuh-tsi̍t-tsuh sàng, koh nā-sī iáu-ū beh pó-tsûn ê mi̍h, àn-liú ē tshiò-kò lí.
entries.effeb4f49021f: $~Guán siu-hók Wordplay tī lí ê kái-sú tsiàn-tsá tshàu-bô tsi̍t-ê tsuan-àn, tsiah lí ê kái-piàn iáu-bē kàu hûn-phuê; tsit-tsūn tsin-tsiàⁿ pó-tsûn liáu-āu tsiah ē tshàu-bô.
entries.e207a320ad1e0: $~Guán siu-hók khang-khang ê <custom characters@https://wordplay.dev/characters> tī kéng-tsik-khì khòaⁿ-bô-tio̍h ê būn-tê; tsit-tsūn ē hián-sī tsò tsi̍t-ê tuān-sòaⁿ ê khuànn.

entries.e5c5bce71059a: $~Lí siá ū lē-tsú thîng-sik-bé ê suat-bîng bûn-kiānn ê sî, tsit-má ē-tàng piau-kì tsi̍t-ê lē-tsú sī /kî-sit/ ū tshò-gō͘, án-ne Wordplay tō bē kā i piau-kì sǹg tshò-gō͘. Tsit-ê tsin ū-iōng, thang hō͘ lâng khuànn tshò-gō͘ sī án-tsuánn.
entries.e37ee7073b3e4: $~Siàng-tsí tsit-má ēng lí ê gí-giân ka-tī ê sò-jī kap hong-keh lâi hián-sī, lí mā ē ēng tsit-khuán tag \5 → ''/hi-IN\ (<1196@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1196>) lâi iàu-kiû tsi̍t-khuán tik-piát ê.
entries.ed1360a42f2c8: $~Guán kái-hó tsiok-tse suat-bîng bûn-kiānn kap kàu-ha̍k lāi-té ê la̍t-tsú thîng-sik, in sui-liân huan-ik liáu tsiūⁿ-tshut-tāi, tsit-má ē tsiàu tsiànn-khuán hián-sī.
entries.e0bc032a5608b: $~Lí ūi Wordplay kéng-tsiah-kuè tsit-khuán gí-giân ê sî, guán tsit-má ē tsiông-sî ēng tsiah-kuè ê gí-giân lâi hián-sī kài-bīn. Tē-it-khuán gí-giân ē hián-sī kah ta̍uh-tsiok-tsiok, kî-thaⁿ gí-giân tsiòng-tī āu-bīn, sió-khuá khah sió koh khah tshing — tsāi piau-tsi̍p, thé-sī, <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide>, kàu-ha̍k, tsiah-kuè tshò-gō sìn-sik mā ū.
entries.e207a197e4d40: $~Guán ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê siá-tsù pâi-lia̍t siat-tīng, lí ê Program ê Output ē-sái tuì téng kàu ē (ti̍t-sik) lâi thàu, m̄-sī tsū-tsiàu tuì tsáu kàu uī. Tsit-ê siat-tīng ē ka-tī tsiàu lí ê gí-giân, mā ē-sái ka-tī kéng tsi̍t-khuán (<220@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/220>).
entries.e1c70694f6767: $~Lí tī <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> khuànn tsi̍t-ê kài-liām ê sî, guán tsit-má ē hián-sī tsi̍t-ê liân-kiat, thàu kàu kà-tsit-ê kài-liām ê khò-bûn, mā ū tsi̍t-tsiah tsò-huat ê tsîng-tan, lí khah-sī ē-sái koh-khah-liáu-kái (<769@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/769>).
entries.ee5dbb239023e: $~Guán tī <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê sû-ji̍p-piáu; lí ē-sái tshâ-tshuē, mā ē-sái tī suat-bîng bûn-kiānn lāi-té ê sû-ji̍p-piáu tsiūⁿ-bīn kā tsiūⁿ-bīn, khuànn tsit-ê sû ê ì-sù (<780@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/780>).
entries.e77d190e94546: $~Guán kā tsuan-àn suat-bîng bûn-kiānn ê tē-it-kù ke-thiam kàu tsuan-àn ê sió-khuá khuànn-khuànn-á lāi-té (<897@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/897>).
entries.ed4e79ad3a490: $~Lí pang-tsān huan-ik Wordplay ê sî, guán tsit-má ē tsí-tshut khah bô-hó-tha̍k ê bûn-jī, mā ē kiàn-gī tī siánn-sî tsi̍t-ê tsiong-iàu ê sû ài liân-kiat kàu sû-ji̍p-piáu, hō͘ huan-ik tshing-tshó koh tsiânn-hó-tha̍k (<460@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/460>).
entries.e2ac3217059d2: $~Guán hō͘ Wordplay tsò kah khah-hó, thàu-kàu Á-la-pik-gí kap Hi-pik-lâi-gí tsiah-nī iu-tsiòng uā ū tsò-sik ê tuì-tsiàu-gí-giân, tsò-tsiah tshài-tan, bûn-jī kap Output lóng ē tuì uá-pîng kàu tsó-pîng liû.
entries.eb16a1590e229: $~Guán tsit-má ēng Claude lâi huan-ik Wordplay, só͘-í huat-tsú khah tshing-tshó, tsiong-iàu ê sû ē tsiân-iū-it, la̍t-tsú thîng-sik mā ē tsiânn huan-ik.
entries.e5c9b94e23f88: $~Guán kái-hó lí kā ka-tī ê tsuan-àn huan-ik kàu kî-thaⁿ gí-giân: miâ, bûn-jī kap suat-bîng bûn-kiānn tsit-má tsò-hóe huan-ik, huat-tsú mā khah tshing-tshó.
entries.ef18c04ffe600: $~Guán tsiàu-tsi̍p-tsāi tsò-huat ê pian-tsi̍p kap khuànn-ê tsik-pán, hō͘ khuànn ê só͘-tsāi ê khuah-tōo khah-tuā.
entries.e39e895538fd5: $~Guán kái-hó <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> lāi-té ê thîng-sik la̍t-tsú, hō͘ lí ē-sái kā in ê tsi̍t-pōo-hūn thuînn kàu lí ê tsuan-àn.
entries.e325ded85463b: $~Tsit-kái tsit-lé-pài sió-khuá tsió, guán kā thîng-sik gí-giân ê to-gí kap bûn-jī tshu-lí ê pōo-hūn tsò khah-uân-tsiânn.
entries.e14f818e941b0: $~Guán ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê tsiok-tuā ê sin guân-sòo kàu thîng-sik gí-giân: mô͘-sik (pattern)! Mā kiò-tsò "tsìng-kuí piáu-ta̍t-sik", in pang-tsān lí kiám-tsa tsi̍t-tuā bûn-jī ū hap-bô tsi̍t-ê mô͘-sik \"@amyjko" ≈ ⣿"@" >0 {_ #}⣿\ ("tsit-tuā bûn-jī sī-m̄-sī tsi̍t-ê at hū-hō ànn-lâi 1 ê á-sī koh-khah-tsōe ê tsû-bóo á-sī sò-jī?"), mā pang-tsān lí tī bûn-jī lāi-té tshuē tsi̍t-ê mô͘-sik \"does my mystery string have a secret code 123456abc?" ⌕ ⣿6 # 3 _⣿\ (tshuē-tshut sóo-ū 6 ê sò-jī ànn-lâi 3 ê tsû-bóo ê suann-sū) (<121@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/121>). Hap-tsiòng ē-sái tsi̍t-pōo tsi̍t-pōo kiânn, lí ē-sái tsi̍t-pōo tsi̍t-pōo kiânn tsi̍t-ê hap-tsiòng, khuànn uī-tì tsìn-tsiânn, tsiah-kuè sàu-kuè ê tōo-hūn ê tsāi-lāi lóng ē thiam-tsiânn, kap hōo-tsiânn ê pīnn-sik kâng-khuán.
entries.ec3e5d12079f2:
$~Guán ke-thiam ē-sái tī thîng-sik-bé lāi-té khuànn kap ēng *tsū-jiân gí-giân ê koan-kiān-sû*, bô-kan-tsāi in ê hû-hō siang-tuì ê. Pí-pán tsiūⁿ-bīn, tiâu-kiānn ê sî, lí ē-sái siá \condition ? a b\ á-sī \condition
then
a
b\, tī Se-pan-gâ-gí tō-sī \condición
entonces
a
b\. Tsit-ê tsò-huat tuì múi-ê lāi-tsāi hû-hō, tī Wordplay sió-tsiah-ê sóo-ū gí-giân lóng ū, só͘-í kâng-tsi̍t-ê Program ē-sái ēng hû-hō á-sī ēng bûn-jī lâi hián-sī tī múi-ê lâng ê gí-giân. Lí ē-sái tī siat-tīng lāi-té thiann-kuè, nā-sī lí ài khah-té ê hû-hō á-sī khah-tn̂g ê sû (<1194@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1194>).
entries.e86ded8f75428: $~Bûn-jī pìng-khui á-sī ha̍p-tsò-hóe ê sî, guán tsit-má ē pó-tsûn kap ha̍p-pīng gí-giân tē-khu (pí-pán, \"hello and"/en + "hola"/es\ tsit-má ē sán-sing \"hello and hola"/en_es\) (<526@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/526>).
entries.e786f9d74083f: $~Guán ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê ūn-sǹg, ē-sái kā gí-giân tē-khu tsòng-ēng kàu tshing-tshó bûn-jī kap ū-kok-sik ê bûn-jī (pí-pán, \("hello" + "world")/en\ kā \/en\ gí-giân tē-khu tsòng-ēng kàu sǹg-tshut-lâi ê bûn-jī) (<1189@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1189>).
entries.ef0e3e8a61b1b: $~Guán kā ū-kok-sik ê bûn-jī ke-thiam kuí-ê ūn-sǹg, kap bûn-jī ūn-sǹg siong-kâng (<1190@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1190>).
entries.e5293d2d7e01e: $~Tshing-tshó bûn-jī kap ū-kok-sik ê bûn-jī sóo-ū ê gí-giân tē-khu sìn-sik, tsit-má lóng ē hán-ìng tī Program ê Output, só͘-í sóo-ū ê bûn-jī pìng-tsò-siaⁿ kong-lêng lóng ē tsiânn-tsiàu gí-giân tsiânn-hó, gí-giân ê siá-tsù hong-hiòng mā ē hō͘ lâng tsūn-tsiàu.
entries.e32b6cef26db6: $~Tsū-tōng khá-liām ê tshài-tan tsit-má ē kiàn-gī ke-thiam ê gí-giân kap tē-khu, nā-sī lí beh iáu-ū siang-gí, sann-gí, á-sī tsiok-tsōe-gí ê bûn-jī! (<884@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/884>).
entries.e0a2d1910562d: $~Guán tī múi-tsi̍t-ê tsū-tōng khá-liām ê kiàn-gī ē-bīn, kap tī <tsí-lâm@https://wordplay.dev/guide> ê thîng-sik ē-bīn ke-thiam sió-khuá-á suat-bîng, hō͘ lí bô-ài tsiok-tsōe tiám-tsiūⁿ-khì tō ē-sái tsai-iánn tsi̍t-ê kài-liām tsò siánn-mih (<1036@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1036>).
entries.ec50300bd7a6d: $~Guán kā tsí-lâm téng-bīn ê hâng-hōo tsí-iânn khah-tsiânn kap iah-tsiat ê tsiah-kuè kéng-tsiah-kuè siong-kâng.
entries.e0457e2f75586: $~Tsit-lé-pài guán kái-hó pian-tsi̍t-khì, siu-tsing kuí-ê bug, koh ke-thiam tsi̍t-ê sin ê khah-té ê kàu-ha̍k, hō͘ í-king tsai-iánn kî-thaⁿ thîng-sik gí-giân ê ha̍k-sing.
entries.ec81b4fdbd0b1: $~Lí tann ē-sái kā tsōng-tsōng ê thîng-sik-bé "tsiah-khui" (fold), án-ni tsiàⁿ tōa-tōa ê Program khuànn khí-lâi khah khuài (<806@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/806>, <883@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/883>).
entries.e83a47b81e36c: $~Gún ka-thiam tsi̍t-ê khuài-sok ê kàu-ha̍k, hōo siūnn beh tsai-iánn Wordplay kap pa̍k-tsióng gí-giân tó-uī bô-kâng ê tsok-tsiá khuànn (<1034@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1034>).
entries.e2e41f451a59a: $~Gún hōo kàu-ha̍k ê piau-kì ū sik-tshái kap hō-bé, án-ni khah ē hun-piat (<1014@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1014>).
entries.e9f4ba7015835: $~Gún siu-lí tsiok-tsē pian-tsi̍p-khì kung-piau tī tsik-bo̍k kap bûn-jī mô-sik ê bô-it-tì ê būn-tê.
entries.ec2a95a0eeef2: $~Gún hōo pian-tsi̍p-khì ê lak-hâ tsia̍h-tan khah kín tshut-hiān, nā-sī tōa ê, kap tsik-bo̍k mô-sik, khah kín.
entries.e8604cf7b9441: $~Gún siu-lí tiāu-sī sî-kan-sûn (debug timeline) ê thoa-tōng.
entries.ea328c0b9a37a: $~Gún kā tsiū-tshut hōng-sik ê soán-tik-khì (nā-sī ū 2 ê í-siōng ê guân-sí-tóng) suá khì pa̍t-uī, bián koh phah-tshìng thong-ti.
entries.eec2ccba5b913: $~Gún hōo kàu-ha̍k ê tsiòng-liàng khah khó-khò (<902@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/902>).
entries.e72b4bc6e2693: $~Gún siu-lí tuann-uī luī-hîng ê tsi̍t-ê būn-tê, í-á ū tsi̍t-kuá luī-hîng tshiong-tu̍t bē khuànn-tio̍h.
entries.e62c0df372193: $~Tsit-pài-lé-pài gún kái-liông tshut-hiān sik-pán, bú-tâi-téng ê tshut-hiān pian-tsi̍p, koh ka-thiam tsi̍t-ê tsik-bo̍k pian-tsi̍p sik-pán.
entries.efb2cc60fd435: $~Ū tsi̍t-ê sin ê tsik-bo̍k pian-tsi̍p sik-pán piⁿ-á, thoa kap lak khah khuài.
entries.e1b591aa2497d: $~Iōng tsik-bo̍k lâi pian-tsi̍p, thua-tsah, khóo-pih kah thiap-tsiah, tsit-má khah it-tì; nā-sī bē-sái thua á-sī thiap, guán ē tī pian-tsi̍p-khì ê kha-pōo kóng sī uī-sím-mi̍h.
entries.e73374fb51f7e: $~Tsit-má ū khóo-pih-pán ê khuànn-tit-tio̍h ê tuì-tsiòng, ē hō͘ lí khuànn khóo-pih tio̍h siánn-mih (<10@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/10>).
entries.e45ad91189c8d: $~Lí siá ū keh-sik ê bûn-jī sî, tsū-tōng khá-tsuân tsit-má ē thê-sī lí ê <ka-tī tsò ê jī@https://wordplay.dev/characters>, lí bē-sái put-su kì in ê miâ tō khá-tsuân, mā ē-sái thīnn tsit-ê khang-uī. (<664@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/664>)

entries.ea2f3af4d20c1: $~Guán ke-tsiânn tsin-tsē sin ê tio̍h-sik tāng-uē, koh ū sin ê tiāu-sik-pán pian-tsi̍p-khì, ē-sái sió-khuànn in ê hāu-kó!
entries.e8d2c965daf9f: $~Guán ke-tsiânn pian-tsi̍p, suá-uī, píng-tsuán kah siók-hóng sûi-ê @Shape ê su-tshut!

entries.ef448e203931c: $~Guán ke-tsiânn tsi̍t-ê siat-tīng, ē-sái kái tab-kiān ê hêng-uî (<758@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/758>).
entries.eff192c2e6b21: $~Tsit-má lí ē-sái tī sik-tsiá kiáu-á-lāi ti̍t-tsiap su-ji̍p sik-tsiá ê miâ, á-sī bāng-iah ē-iōng ê thîng-sik-bé. (<443@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/443>)
entries.e3daaac9b027d: $~Guán tī bûn-jī pian-tsi̍p ê mo̍-sik ke-tsiânn "nńg" kuànn-hâng, tn̂g-hâng khah-ē khuànn (<1173@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1173>).

entries.e05e022646397: $~Tsit-má bô suán sím-mih sî, tiāu-sik-pán ê ke-hō͘ àn-liú tsí ē tsò ū-tsiâu-hô ê piàn-hua, ná-tsūn kā @Phrase pau tī @Group lāi. Nā-sī lí ê tsîng-sik sī khang-khang, guán ē kiàn-gī ke tsi̍t-ê @Phrase lâi khai-sí.
entries.e7716fd08201a: $~Tī bú-tâi suán tsē-tsē-ê, í-tsiông tsí ē-sái iōng tsí-tsīng-khì; tsit-má khí-pan mā ē-sái (<118@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/118>).
entries.ef7eb063a942b: $~Tsit-lé-pài guán hō͘ khàm-tòng khah kín koh khah khó-khiàu.

entries.e5ce4f5ebde49: $~Guán hō͘ tsiàm-ji̍p, kái-sin kah khàm-tòng ê tshò-gō͘ hián-sī khah it-tì koh khah khó-khiàu.
entries.ebf0dc59f4291: $~Pian-tsi̍p-khì ū tsin-tsē tshiong-tu̍t ê sî, guán hō͘ lí khah-ē kuè-khì ta̍k-ê khuànn.

entries.e9d6bb051880e: $~Guán siu-tsíng tī ōe-tong-ê tuì-ōe-khuànn lāi ê thiàu-tshut-lâi ê thê-sī. (<1177@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/1177>)
entries.ed952469fc24a: $~Siok-tshūn tsit-má khah kín, mā khah khó-khōo, nā-sī bāng-lō bān, tsuan-àn kài-tsōe, a̍h-sī lí bāng-lō tsū-tsiah tn̄g-tuān-tuān (<812@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/812>).
entries.ebcfc80b68311: $~Tsit lé-pài tsú-yàu kái-siān tsí-lâm ê tsin-tsōe tè-ták, pau-kuat sok-tōo, hó-īng, kah kái bug. entries.e3dd338dc5b94: $~*Kā tián-lám-kuán iáh tsíng-lí hó-sè*. Lí ê, lē-tsú, kah kong-khai ê tián-lám-kuán, tsit-má lóng tī tián-lám-kuán iáh khuànn--tio̍h (<594@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/594>, <799@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/799>).

entries.ee82a32aa9c5a: $~*Sin ê gí-giân*. Goán ka-thiam ki-khì hoan-ik ê tshau-kó: /A-la-pik-gí, Hi-lia̍p-gí, Kannada, Telugu, kah Assam-gí/! Goán tsai-iánn iáu ū tsiok-tsē thang kái-siān ê tē-hng, in-uī AI iáu bē ân-tsiânn, nā-sī lí beh pang-tsān kái-siān, ài kā goán liân-lo̍k.
entries.e7cfef86a9ad1: $~*Tsí-lâm lāi-té ê miâ*. Goán kā ta̍k-ê hâm-sik, kiat-kò͘, kah tsu-liāu-liû ê miâ lóng ka-thiam khì tsí-lâm, hōo lí khah-iōng-ī tsai-iánn in ū tsiok-tsē ê tsē-gí miâ (<934@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/934>).

entries.ec06b7d006791: $~*Sin ê kng-sin iáh*! Goán tso tsit-ê iáh hōo lí khuànn-tio̍h tsiah-nî ū siánn-mih piàn-hua; iáu-bē hoan-ik kàu ta̍k-ê gí-giân, m̄-kú lí ê liû-lám-khì kiám-ū thang pang-tsān (<351@https://github.com/wordplaydev/wordplay/issues/351>).
